title: A Black Hole Crash Briefly Outshone Every Star Combined

scenes.text: Two black holes crashed and outshone every star.
They were 36 and 29 times heavier than our Sun.
In about a fifth of a second, they merged. Three Suns of mass turned into ripples in space.
For that instant, the power was about 50 times all the stars in the universe combined.
It happened 1.3 billion light-years away. Detectors on Earth caught the ripple in 2015.
A crash you can't see, brighter than every star.

description:
Two black holes crashed and briefly outshone every star in the universe.
The merger turned about three Suns of mass into gravitational waves in a fraction of a second.
What is the biggest thing you can imagine?
first_comment: A fraction of a second, 50 times the power of every star. Which is wilder: that, or that we measured it?
